name: Custom Shape Acrylic Standing Game Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic material, offering a bright, modern, and durable display finish.
    - Features a custom shape standing game box design with layered acrylic pieces for a lively and eye-catching 3D effect.
    - All main parts are made from 3mm acrylic, providing a sturdy structure while keeping the product lightweight and easy to display.
    - Smooth cut edges and clear acrylic surfaces enhance the printed artwork with a clean and polished appearance.
    - Available in 2 layout options: 2 Wall and 3 Wall, depending on the design style and display preference.
    - Custom decorative pieces are included to create a more personalized and vivid scene.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
                      +) 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm.
                      +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.
                      +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
    - Minimum size of custom acrylic piece: 2 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Support 2-sided printing for all parts.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a personalized decorative display and themed acrylic scene box.
    - Designed for tabletop display on desks, shelves, counters, or memory corners.
    - Creates a layered 3D visual effect that makes custom characters and backgrounds more lively and engaging.
    - Perfect for showcasing school themes, hobbies, professions, family moments, or personalized characters.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, celebration displays, and keepsake collections.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for kids, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for school-themed gifts, hobby-inspired keepsakes, and character-based custom displays.
    - A thoughtful gift for teachers, students, gardeners, pet lovers, and anyone who enjoys personalized décor.
    - Great for holiday gifting, commemorative moments, and unique surprise presents.
    - Adds a fun, creative, and memorable touch to any personal space 🎁

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
